name: Superhero
definition: A catalogued super-powered character. It is the central entity of the database: every hero is identified by a display name and described by physical measurements, categorical classifications (gender, race, alignment, publisher) and rated capabilities.
scope: Superhero catalogue analysis; the anchor entity for hero-level filtering, aggregation and ranking

name: Superhero Name
definition: The display name that identifies a superhero in the catalogue (for example '3-D Man', 'Hawkman', 'Speedy'). It is the label a question asks for when it asks who or which hero.
scope: Hero identification, name-based lookup and name-based filtering

name: Full Name
definition: The civilian or real full name recorded for a superhero. It is very frequently unrecorded, so absence of a full name is a normal catalogue state rather than an anomaly.
scope: Hero identity detail; used when a question asks for the full name of a hero rather than the hero name

name: Publisher
definition: A company that publishes superheroes. Each superhero record may reference exactly one publisher, and a publisher is associated with many superheroes.
scope: Publisher-level aggregation, comparison and filtering (for example DC versus Marvel)

name: Superpower
definition: A named ability in the controlled power vocabulary (for example 'Agility', 'Stealth', 'Super Strength'). Superpowers are linked to heroes through hero-to-power association records, and a hero may have several powers.
scope: Ability coverage, ability-based filtering and per-hero ability listing

name: Rated Attribute Dimension
definition: One of the six rated capability dimensions on which a hero may be scored: Intelligence, Strength, Speed, Durability, Power and Combat.
scope: Capability rating analysis; selects which rating column a superlative question refers to

name: Attribute Rating Value
definition: The numeric score that a hero receives on one rated attribute dimension. All dimensions share a single 0-100 scale on which a higher value means a greater capability. Not every hero has rating records, so the rating population is smaller than the hero population.
scope: Capability comparison, ranking and extremum analysis over rated attributes

name: Extremum Hero by Attribute
definition: The superhero that holds the highest or the lowest rating on a selected attribute dimension. It is the semantic target behind superlative questions such as fastest, strongest, smartest or dumbest. The concept is not stored as a column: it is identified by comparing attribute ratings within one dimension and then resolving the owning hero.
scope: Superlative and ranking questions over rated attributes

name: Colour Vocabulary
definition: The shared controlled colour vocabulary from which appearance colour labels are drawn. It contains 35 exact, capitalised labels including simple colours ('Blue', 'Black', 'Blond'), compound labels ('Black/Blue', 'Brown/White') and the sentinel label 'No Colour' that marks an unrecorded colour.
scope: Appearance colour labelling for eyes, hair and skin

name: Eye Colour
definition: The eye colour recorded for a superhero, expressed as a value of the shared colour vocabulary.
scope: Appearance filtering, colour popularity and colour comparisons

name: Hair Colour
definition: The hair colour recorded for a superhero, expressed as a value of the shared colour vocabulary.

name: Skin Colour
definition: The skin colour recorded for a superhero, expressed as a value of the shared colour vocabulary.

name: Gender
definition: The gender classification recorded for a superhero. Values are the exact labels 'Male', 'Female' and 'N/A', where 'N/A' marks an unknown gender.
scope: Gender-based filtering, counting and per-gender grouping

name: Race
definition: The species or origin label recorded for a superhero. There are 61 distinct values (for example 'Human', 'Mutant', 'Kryptonian'). Values are atomic discriminating labels, so origin families are recorded as separate values rather than as one value with sub-types.

name: Alignment
definition: The moral alignment recorded for a superhero. Values are the exact labels 'Good', 'Bad', 'Neutral' and 'N/A', where 'N/A' marks an unknown alignment.

name: Height
definition: The recorded height of a superhero, expressed in centimetres. Height is recorded for most heroes but is missing for a substantial minority, in which case the value is encoded rather than genuinely zero.
scope: Physical measurement filtering, ranges and percentage-of-total analysis

name: Weight
definition: The recorded weight of a superhero, expressed in kilograms. Weight is missing for a large minority of heroes, in which case the value is encoded rather than genuinely zero.
scope: Physical measurement filtering and missing-data analysis

name: Superhero Count
definition: The number of distinct superheroes that satisfy a given filter or grouping. It is the semantic basis for how-many questions, publisher comparisons, colour popularity ranking and percentage shares of a filtered total.
scope: Counting, publisher/colour comparison and share-of-total analysis
